{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Count total enrolled patients
total_patients = len(df)

# Count patients with SEVERE baseline disease
severe_patients = df[df['severity'] == 'severe'].shape[0]

# Compute fraction
fraction_severe = severe_patients / total_patients

# Print each number explicitly as required
print(total_patients)
print(severe_patients)
print(fraction_severe)"}
